what: no-fallback: `Writer::keep` (crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/work.rs:335) returns None when a write fails to apply or a reader is still alive, and job.rs:2187 `if let Some(kept) = writer.keep()` then silently drops the front end, so the head next build lowers anew (a full re-lower in place of an incremental one, reason dropped). Make it `fn keep(self) -> Result<S::KeptFront, ApiError>` (or a typed reason) and have job.rs end the build with the error. Once the trait changes I will change `UnitWriter::keep` in serve/unit.rs:407 to return `Err` with the apply error / a typed `still read` reason; tell me and I edit unit.rs the same round.

history.note: Writer::keep -> Result<S::KeptFront, ApiError> (serve/work.rs); UnitWriter::keep (serve/unit.rs) and the fake (serve/tests.rs) return an error naming why (a reader still alive, a holder still alive, an apply error); job.rs ends the build with it (already in the tree).
